title: Fast and low-cost evaluation of hydroxykynurenine activity
author: Maciel, dos Anjos, et al.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make the following stock solutions freshly: 0.1 M HCl, 0.1 M NaOH, and a HEPES buffer consisting of 10 mL of 1 M HEPES‑NaOH (pH 7.5), 25 mL of 4 M NaCl, and ultrapure water added to a final volume of 50 mL.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve appropriate amount of HCl in water to obtain 0.1 M HCl.
Dissolve appropriate amount of NaOH in water to obtain 0.1 M NaOH.
Combine 10 mL 1 M HEPES‑NaOH (pH 7.5) with 25 mL 4 M NaCl, then add ultrapure H₂O up to 50 mL total.

steps.title: Prepare stock reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the following reagent stocks: 100 mM FeCl₃·6H₂O and 20 mM pyridoxal‑5′‑phosphate (PLP) hydrate.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 135.2 mg FeCl₃·6H₂O, dissolve in 0.1 M HCl and bring the volume to 5 mL (100 mM stock).
Weigh 34.3 mg pyridoxal‑5′‑phosphate hydrate, dissolve in 0.1 M NaOH and bring the volume to 7 mL (20 mM stock).

steps.title: Prepare working reagents
steps.instruction: Using the stock solutions and reagents, prepare all working solutions required for the assay.

substeps.instruction: 25 mM 3‑D,L‑hydroxykynurenine (3‑HK): dissolve 11.22 mg in HEPES buffer and bring to 2 mL; store at –20 °C (prepared previously).
20 mM xanthurenic acid (XA): dissolve 16.4 mg in 0.1 M NaOH and bring to 4 mL.
0.5 mM PLP: add 0.25 mL of the 20 mM PLP stock to HEPES buffer and bring the final volume to 10 mL.
50 mM sodium pyruvate: dissolve 55 mg in HEPES buffer and bring to 10 mL.
10 mM Fe(III) chloride: add 1 mL of the 100 mM FeCl₃ stock to 0.1 M HCl and bring the volume to 10 mL.
Recombinant HKT enzyme: prepare a solution at 0.1 µg/µL (0.1 µg µL⁻¹).
